notes: The first AFL++ verification failed: order-default-ns.xml gave different maps on repeat because expat draws a random hash salt per parser. The harness now calls the documented XML_SetHashSalt with a fixed non-zero value; all receipts were regenerated after that change.

The libFuzzer binary instruments only the harness; libexpat is compiled with LLVM coverage flags. Parser-level fuzz feedback comes from the AFL++ overlay, where build.sh's clang calls, including configure CC, become afl-clang-fast.

libxml2 2.15.4 is the second verified path: a committed xmlReaderForMemory/xmlTextReaderRead project, receipt and AFL++ overlay. It needed no determinism change; its control maps repeated identically. The expat and libxml2 receipts were not regenerated by each other's work; the expat manifest's coverage_limit still mentions the earlier scratch libxml2 run because that file is hash-pinned by the expat receipt.
verify_c_xml_feedback.py now checks both paths and writes data/c/xml/afl-feedback.json as schema_version 2 with a results list, like data/go/xml.

Mini-XML 4.0.6 is the third verified path (libmxml1 2,054). Mini-XML does not implement Namespaces in XML, so harness.c resolves expanded names, declarations and URIs from mxml's tree with an in-scope binding stack. The match therefore verifies mxml's element, attribute and text parsing together with the adapter's namespace resolution, not namespace processing in mxml.

mxmlLoadString is called with top NULL, as documented; mxml then makes the <?xml?> declaration the parent of the rest of the document, so the harness walks children of every node and counts depth only for elements. Mini-XML's configure appends OPTIM='-g -Os' after the project CFLAGS, so libmxml4.a is built at -Os in both the coverage and AFL++ images.

The expat and libxml2 base and overlay images from their receipts were not in this machine's Docker cache. verify_c_xml_feedback.py now accepts path slugs; it was run for mxml only, and the expat and libxml2 results in afl-feedback.json are carried over unchanged from their earlier run. Their receipts were not rebuilt.
